{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature/purpose of the asset or good being expensed (asset-centric characterization of expense records)",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "asset_category_primary", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Directly types the asset being expensed (laptop, desktop, service), a core facet of the asset-purpose focus."},
    {"name": "asset_portability_context", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Characterizes the asset by portability/usage context, a coherent facet of the asset concept."},
    {"name": "record_creation_signal", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Provenance of how the record was created; a process/metadata facet only loosely tied to the asset focus."},
    {"name": "vendor_brand_primary", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Vendor/brand of the asset is a strong attribute of what was purchased, supporting asset-centric analysis."},
    {"name": "processing_lag_indicator", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Timing/processing metric unrelated to the asset nature; belongs to a different (operational) focus."},
    {"name": "asset_specification_richness", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Describes how precisely the asset is specified, a facet about the asset/description quality."},
    {"name": "asset_expense_purpose", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "The functional purpose of the expense (hardware provisioning, travel, service) is the central asset-purpose facet."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.72,
  "structure_quality": 0.7,
  "focus_actionability": 0.75,
  "rationale": "Five of seven columns (category, portability, brand, specification richness, expense purpose) converge cleanly on a single, data-inferable focus: what asset/good the expense represents and why. This is coherent and not a grab-bag. Two columns (record_creation_signal, processing_lag_indicator) drift toward a separate operational/process theme, diluting the centering somewhat. Given the asset focus, the supporting columns form a genuine multi-facet structure (type, portability, vendor, purpose, specification granularity) rather than a single restatement or generic noise, and they enable real analysis such as spend by asset type, vendor concentration, and provisioning purpose. The focus is actionable — an analyst can investigate hardware vs. service spend, vendor consolidation, and portability/usage patterns. Scores are moderated by the two off-focus columns and by some near-overlap between asset_category_primary and asset_expense_purpose."
}
